proposal.acceptance: The plugin will be implemented as a ROS node that subscribes to the `image` topic, processes the PNG image, and publishes the width and height as a ROS message.
proposal.behavior: The node will read the PNG image, decode it, and then extract the width and height. It will then publish these dimensions as a `sensor_msgs/ImageDimension` message.
proposal.dependencies: The plugin requires the `sensor_msgs` package for the image dimensions message.
proposal.inputs: The plugin requires the `image` topic to be published by the ROS node that generates the PNG image.
proposal.outputs: The plugin publishes the width and height as a `sensor_msgs/ImageDimension` message.
proposal.permissions: The plugin requires the `image` topic to be published by the ROS node that generates the PNG image.
proposal.rollback: If the plugin fails to publish the dimensions, it will publish an error message indicating the failure and the reason for the failure.
